A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

triorganotin derivatives with a high degree of steric hindrance (tributyl- and triphenyltins) are cytotoxic, while triorganogermanium derivatives with high steric hindrance and triorganotins with low steric hindrance are not.
the cytotoxicity of the tested organotin derivatives is independent of their ligand binding properties, but the ability to modulate migration is related to the ligand binding properties.
the cytotoxicity and migration of MDA-MB 231 cells is not only dependent on the ligand, but also on the type of organometallics, i.e. alkyl- or aryl- containing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
organometallic tin compounds are highly cytotoxic and induce apoptosis in MDA-MB 231 breast cancer cells, but the organometallic germanium derivatives are not.
organotin compounds are cytotoxic and cause apoptosis in triple negative breast cancer.
